how.title: Tell me what you need
how.text: Send your details with the quote form.

how.title: Get your quote
how.text: I reply with a price and what is included.

how.text: You see it take shape and ask for changes.

how.title: Launch
how.text: Your site goes live and you can edit it yourself.

faq.q: How long does a website take?
faq.a: It depends on the size. Most sites take from a few days to a couple of weeks.

faq.q: What do I need to give you?
faq.a: Your business name, logo, photos and the main details. If you do not have photos yet, we can start with placeholders.

faq.q: Who pays for the domain and hosting?
faq.a: You pay for your own domain. I explain any hosting cost before we start.

faq.q: Can I edit the site myself?
faq.a: Yes. Your site comes with a simple admin page for changing text, photos and prices.
